properties.notes: Site is identified as a Development Opportunity Area in the adopted Fareham Local Plan Part 2 (2015) and identified as a proposed Fareham Town Centre mixed use allocation in the emerging Local Plan. This identifies a capacity of 100 dwellings for the site (excluding potential hotel use on upper floors). A car park currently serves the commercial shopping and retail core forming the town centre.
